field_principles.adversarial_controls: Records duplicate, contradictory, no-op, infeasible, leakage, split, shortcut, and objective controls.
field_principles.benchmark_manifest_path: Points to the full sealed acquisition manifest.
field_principles.benchmark_row_hashes: Seals every selected acquisition case row.
field_principles.blocked_reasons: Lists mechanical blockers when the benchmark is not ready.
field_principles.ca_benchmark_ready_score: Bare scalar that unlocks downstream acquisition consumers only when every exact gate passes.
field_principles.distinguishing_query_receipts: Seals query hashes and minimality evidence for each variant.
field_principles.domain_artifact_hashes: Seals natural-language, variable-domain, and transition artifacts by case.
field_principles.exact_validator_disagreement_count: Bare scalar blocking primary versus independent validator disagreement.
field_principles.expected_repair_receipts: Seals expected lifecycle add/remove/noop operations for each variant.
field_principles.experiment: Numeric experiment id for result indexing.
field_principles.experiment_id: Stable slug for conductor and artifact lookup.
field_principles.faithful_model_hashes: Seals canonical faithful typed model AST/text by case.
field_principles.family_counts: Proves balanced coverage across finite CSP, MaxSAT, packing, and planning.
field_principles.field_principles: Every artifact field states the evidence boundary it protects.
field_principles.generator_source_hash: Seals the Exp5761 source file that generated the rows.
field_principles.generator_version: Pins the deterministic Exp5761 generator version.
field_principles.hard_soft_role_receipts: Proves mutations preserve hard versus soft roles.
field_principles.honest_verdict: Terminal state starts complete: or blocked: and names the readiness boundary.
field_principles.inference_substrate: Declares deterministic exact solver dataset generation with no LLM.
field_principles.instance_count: Records the number of faithful source cases.
field_principles.llm_inference_used: Bare false proves no LLM contaminated benchmark generation.
field_principles.membership_query_count: Counts minimal discriminating membership queries for non-faithful variants.
field_principles.methodology_note: Explains exact 1.0 gate scores as deterministic replay gates, not statistical classifier claims.
field_principles.milestone: Milestone accountability for this benchmark build.
field_principles.mixed_model_hashes: Seals variants that combine deletion and spurious restriction by case.
field_principles.model_specs: Declares the offline exact generator in place of any LLM model.
field_principles.negative_assignment_count: Counts exact rejected assignment witnesses for every variant.
field_principles.positive_assignment_count: Counts exact accepted assignment witnesses for every variant.
field_principles.preconditions_checked: Records upstream replay, solver, provenance, seed, RAM, disk, and reconstruction gates before generation.
field_principles.producer_gate_fields: Lists top-level bare scalars exported to conductor gates.
field_principles.random_seed: Legacy scalar seed for methodology linters.
field_principles.random_seeds: Records source selection, mutation, query, and control seeds.
field_principles.reproducibility_checksum: Hashes the artifact with its checksum field blanked.
field_principles.result_path: Names the JSON artifact written by this workflow.
field_principles.run_date: Absolute run date 20260721 avoids relative-date ambiguity.
field_principles.schema: Pins the Exp5761 artifact schema for downstream validators.
field_principles.science_row_hashes: Exposes held-out science case commitments for downstream learner audits.
field_principles.solution_receipt_failure_count: Blocks unsatisfiable variants or missing assignment witnesses.
field_principles.solver_versions: Pins primary and independent exact validator implementations.
field_principles.spec_refs: Binds the artifact to REQ-BENCH-5761, REQ-LEARN-5761, and REQ-STORE-5761.
field_principles.status: Bare terminal state used by downstream gates.
field_principles.structure_receipt_failure_count: Blocks semantic no-op mutations or role drift.
field_principles.test_commands: Records focused, coverage, full-suite, spec, adversarial, and root-clutter commands.
field_principles.test_exit_codes: Records observed or preregistered verification command exit codes.
field_principles.train_dev_science_disjoint_score: Bare scalar proving selected split memberships are disjoint.
field_principles.upstream_artifact_hashes: Seals Exp5746 artifact, manifest, and generator source inputs.
field_principles.variant_counts: Proves faithful, incomplete, over-fit, and mixed variants exist per case.
field_principles.verifier_is_oracle: Bare true records exact validators as the only correctness authority.

methodology_note: Gate scores of 1.0 are exact replay conjunctions over finite domains, not stochastic classifier performance.
